question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Miracle Makers: Indian Cricket's Greatest Epic'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Sundaresan**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• *'*The Miracle Makers: Indian Cricket's Greatest Epic' is a book written by **Bharat Sundaresan**, a well-known cricket journalist and author.
 
• The book highlights India's historic Test series win against Australia in 2020-21, often referred to as one of India's greatest cricketing achievements.
 
• The victory was notable for India's comeback after being bowled out for 36 in the first Test, and their eventual triumph despite injuries and the absence of key players.
 
• Bharat Sundaresan, along with co-author Gaurav Joshi, provides detailed insights, behind-the-scenes stories, and exclusive interviews about the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About the Book 'The Miracle Makers: Indian Cricket's Greatest Epic'**

 
 
• The book chronicles the remarkable journey of the Indian cricket team, highlighting their significant achievements and the challenges they overcame.
 
• It provides an in-depth look at some of the most memorable matches and moments in Indian cricket history.
 
• The book delves into the strategies, player performances, and the behind-the-scenes efforts that contributed to the team's success.
 
• It is a tribute to the spirit, determination, and excellence of Indian cricketers over the years.
 
 
 
• **Indian Cricket Team**
 
 
• The Indian cricket team, also known as Team India, represents India in international cricket.
 
• The team is governed by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• India is one of the strongest teams in international cricket, having won multiple ICC tournaments, including the Cricket World Cup and the T20 World Cup.
 
• Indian cricket has produced numerous legendary players who have made significant contributions to the sport globally.
 
 
 
• **Cricket in India**
 
 
• Cricket is the most popular sport in India, enjoyed by millions of fans across the country.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) is one of the most-watched and lucrative cricket leagues globally.
 
• Cricket has a rich history in India, with the first recorded match being played in 1721.
 
• The sport has a significant cultural impact and is considered a unifying force in the diverse nation of India.
